parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-24 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1101.7 | 4.18 | 4.18
2 | 1144.4 | 12.44 | 16.62
3 | 549.8 | 0.62 | 17.24
4 | 173.3 | 7.65 | 24.89
5 | 2079.8 | 25.05 | 49.94
6 | 1111.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KQHK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-24
Curve type: KQHK-type
Aquifer depth: 17.24 – 24.89 m
Recommendation: Drill to a depth of approximately 28 to 30 m to fully penetrate the low-resistivity aquifer layer and terminate into the top of the underlying resistive bedrock. Install screen casing across the saturated zone between 17.2 m and 24.9 m.
